message.content: {"obligations":[{"id":"EXCHANGE_PROTOCOL","label":"C","source_lines":[16,24,31,36,41,46],"reason":"Each arm signals its own item-bound ready event after depositing/clearing its pad, waits for the peer ready event before picking up the peer item, and clears the peer event with the matching receipt version after the carried move; this matches the reciprocal exchange protocol."},{"id":"EXCHANGE_RECEIPT","label":"C","source_lines":[31,34,36,41,44,46],"reason":"The exact EventReceipt returned by wait_event is passed to the carried move to the arm's own target and its version is used for clear_event, preserving the peer-item receipt dependency."},{"id":"LONG_RANGE_DEPENDENCY","label":"C","source_lines":[31,34,41,44],"reason":"The focal dependency right_ready -> LEFT carried move is implemented: consume_left waits for right_ready and passes that receipt to the LEFT move to left_target; the symmetric left_ready -> RIGHT carried move is also present."},{"id":"SUPPORT_DEPARTURE","label":"C","source_lines":[14,15,22,23,35,37,45,47],"reason":"Every release is immediately followed in the same coroutine by a same-arm separating move: left_pad->left_clear, right_pad->right_clear, left_target->left_depart, right_target->right_depart."},{"id":"TASK_GOAL","label":"C","source_lines":[11,12,13,14,15,19,20,21,22,23,31,32,33,34,35,36,37,41,42,43,44,45,46,47],"reason":"The code deposits left_part on left_pad and right_part on right_pad, then exchanges them so left_part ends at right_target and right_part at left_target, with arms moving to left_depart/right_depart and both ready events cleared."}]}
